instructions.description: Lie on your back on the floor or exercise mat and bend your legs so your feet are planted with the soles of your feet on the floor or mat.
Place your hands behind your head or on opposite shoulders.
Exhale and use your stomach muscles to bring yourself up into a sitting position.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the mat while keeping the movement controlled and contracting your stomach muscles.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.
